units.source_text: 那个花散里为了源氏公子之事无限悲伤，

en.t: That Hanachirusato was deeply saddened over Prince Genji's affairs,

units.source_text: 常常寄书慰问，这原是理之当然。

en.t: and it was only natural that she often sent letters asking after him and offering comfort.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“若不与她再见一面，

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "If I do not see her once more,
she will resent me for being heartless."

units.source_text: 便决心在这天晚间前去访问。

en.t: So he resolved to visit her that very evening.

units.source_text: 然而又舍不得紫姬，所以直到深夜方才出门。

en.t: Yet he could not bear to leave Lady Murasaki, and so he did not set out until late at night.

units.source_text: 丽景殿女御喜出望外，说道：“寒舍亦得列入数中，蒙大驾亲临！”

en.t: The Reikeiden lady was overjoyed beyond expectation and said, "To think that even this humble house should be counted among those honored by your visit!"
There is no need to describe in detail how delighted she was.

units.source_text: 这姐妹两人生涯实甚清寒，年来全赖源氏公子荫庇，孤苦度日。

en.t: The two sisters lived in truly straitened circumstances, and for years had passed their lonely days entirely under Prince Genji's protection.

units.source_text: 目前邸内景况已够凄凉，将来势必更加困苦。

en.t: The present state of the residence was already bleak enough, and in the future their hardship was bound to grow worse.
At that time the moonlight was hazy,

units.source_text: 源氏公子怅望庭中池塘、假山、茂林等岑寂之状，

en.t: and Prince Genji gazed sadly at the lonely scene of the garden pond, the artificial hill, the thick woods, and the rest,

units.source_text: 便想象今后流放中的岩穴生涯。

en.t: imagining the life in a rocky cave that awaited him in exile.
